units.source_text: 十日早晨，名人的病情没有变化。

en.t: On the morning of the tenth, the Master’s condition had not changed.
The doctor agreed to let him play the match.

units.source_text: 他的脸仍然浮肿，身体明显衰弱。

en.t: His face was still swollen, and his body was visibly weakened.

units.source_text: 也是那天早上，有人问名人：今天的对局场地是在本馆还是在别馆？

en.t: Also that morning, someone asked the Master: Is today’s match to be held in the main building or in the annex?

units.source_text: 名人答道：我已经不能走动了。

en.t: The Master answered: I can no longer walk about.

units.source_text: 不过，前些时候大竹七段说过，本馆房间瀑布声嘈杂，还是由大竹七段来定夺吧。

en.t: However, some time ago Otake Seventh Dan said that the sound of the waterfall in the main building room was noisy, so let Otake Seventh Dan decide after all.

units.source_text: 瀑布是用自来水人工造的，于是决定把瀑布关闭，在本馆弈战。

en.t: The waterfall was an artificial one made with tap water, so it was decided to turn it off and play the match in the main building.

units.source_text: 我听到名人这番话，一股似是愤懑的哀伤涌上了心头。

en.t: When I heard these words from the Master, a sorrow almost like indignation welled up in my heart.
